summary: Send the owner only license and org counts
description: OWN-01 through OWN-05, P4, and P9. The default channel sends nothing. The revocation body and the optional usage report contain org-level counts only. An owner response cannot change config.
scope: Both payloads exclude prompts and user ids
The report is off by default and an owner body does not change config
acceptanceCriteria: revocation_payload keys are exactly license_id and org_id. usage_report keys are exactly active_seats, total_requests, total_tokens, and tokens_saved_est. preview returns that dict. usage_report_enabled false makes send_usage_report return sent false without calling transport. apply_owner_response returns the same compact_threshold. OWN-01 OWN-02 OWN-03 OWN-04 OWN-05 P4 P9.
constraints: Do not include a user id or a prompt in either payload.
Do not send the usage report when it is disabled.
Do not apply commands from an owner response.
